videos.desc: A young woman and man sit at a bright table sketching pencil drawings of a chair, comparing versions and adding measurements. They then cut cardboard, build a small model chair from their sketch, test it with a stone on the seat, and high-five when the design works.
videos.said: That one, that's it. And it actually works!

videos.desc: A girl opens an old keepsake box in the hallway and goes through each memory inside: she holds a seashell to her ear, ties on an old friendship bracelet, and smiles at a childhood beach photo of her and a friend. She then laces up her old roller skates, finds they still fit and rolls down the hall grinning at the photo.

In a Pixar-style autumn park, a girl plays chess against a taunting opponent. She taps her temple, closes her eyes, and a thought bubble over her head shows the board with her moves planned as dotted lines. She calmly plays the winning move and smiles smugly as the opponent slumps in defeat.
videos.said: You've got nothing! Wait, let me think. All up here. No!

videos.desc: A young woman sits at a chess board in a tournament hall while the spectators packed behind the rope barrier behind her wave their arms, pull faces and gesture at her to break her concentration; she never looks up, and calmly reaches out and moves a piece.

A student with silver-grey hair, glasses and headphones round his neck sits at a table in a busy study hall covered in small paper cards. He presses one card against his forehead with his eyes closed while he tries to say the answer, then looks at it to check, and works through card after card until the pile in front of him has grown into a heap. At the end he throws his fist up and grins, having got them all.

Two rangers in matching khaki uniforms work on green coastal hills. They spread a white map over the bonnet of their truck and study it, then carry wooden stakes topped with orange flags up the slope and push them into the ground one after another, so that a line of orange flags curves over the ridge. An aerial shot shows the finished flag line running across the hillside down towards the sea, and one ranger steps back, takes off her hat and looks along it.

A huge grey dragon perches on a rocky mountain ridge at sunset. Its wide leathery wings are spread, lit orange by the low sun, and its scaly body is covered with spikes. It folds its wings and lowers its long horned head, its claws gripping the rock and sending loose stones and dust tumbling down, and a puff of breath comes from its mouth while small birds scatter. Below are dark pine trees and a valley filled with clouds, and behind it rise jagged peaks glowing pink and orange under a clear blue sky.

In a harbour with colourful wooden fishing boats in front of a honey-coloured church with two bell towers, a young priest in a white robe over a black cassock stands on the stone quay, raises a metal sprinkler and splashes water toward a young woman in a yellow jacket and rubber boots. She stands on a blue and yellow boat with her head bowed and her hands pressed together, then looks up and smiles at him with a hand on her chest as he lowers the sprinkler. Orange nets and ropes lie on the boat.

Inside a huge Gothic cathedral with pointed arches, stone pillars and a round rose window, shafts of sunlight shine through incense smoke. An older man in long cream and gold robes and a tall pointed cream and gold hat raises one hand in blessing and holds a tall staff with a curled top. Beside him a young server in a white robe swings a smoking silver incense holder on chains. Rows of people sit on wooden chairs and watch.

On a rainy cobbled square outside an old stone church, a young clergyman in a long gold embroidered cloak over a white robe, with a silver cross on his chest, stands with his eyes closed and one hand raised in blessing. Behind him a big dappled grey horse on a lead grabs his tall pointed gold-and-white hat in its teeth and lifts it off his head into the air. The young woman holding the horse gasps, and villagers with a goat and umbrellas watch.

Inside a train carriage at night, a young man with a beard, a denim shirt and a white T-shirt sits fast asleep in his seat with his eyes closed and a happy smile, waving both arms high in the air as if cheering. A sandwich and a paper coffee cup sit on the table in front of him. Other passengers watch, amused, and a woman covers her mouth. A small brown dog in the aisle moves up to the table and sniffs at the sandwich, and lights streak past the window.

A dark green bronze statue of a griffin stands on a stone pillar at the end of an old bridge wall at dusk. The creature has an eagle's head and huge spread feathered wings on a lion's body with a long tail, and one clawed foot is raised. A crow flies in and lands on the tip of its wing. A glowing street lamp stands beside it, wet cobblestones shine with puddles, and behind it a stone arch bridge crosses a misty river towards gothic towers under a stormy sky.

Under a huge banyan tree with long hanging roots, an old man with a long white beard, a red mark on his forehead and orange robes holds up a dry, see-through leaf and turns it in his fingers as he talks. Young people sit behind him and listen. Then the view widens: he sits cross-legged on a mat and teaches a circle of young men and women in jumpers and hoodies sitting barefoot on mats, a notebook beside one of them. A brass water pot stands on the dusty ground and a bell hangs from a branch in soft misty light.

At a small roadside shrine under a big old tree on a misty morning, a woman in a pale blue sari stands barefoot on a stone step and gently touches a dark carved stone statue of a god, dressed in red cloth and hung with thick orange marigold garlands. She then steps back, presses her palms together, bows her head and prays, and looks up at the statue. Brass oil lamps, incense and a plate of fruit stand on the ledge in front of it, a brass bell hangs from a branch and two men with a bicycle stand on the road behind.

A cosy old café with bookshelves and framed portraits on the walls. A young man with curly black hair, glasses and a beard, in a brown corduroy jacket and black polo neck, argues passionately with his mouth wide open, pointing at a tall stack of books full of sticky notes, and draws a diagram with a fountain pen. He then laughs and touches his glasses. At the marble table with espresso cups and sugar cubes, a young woman sits with her arms crossed and frowns, while a man beside him laughs. Brass lamps glow.

At night on a beach under a full moon, a young woman with long curly hair, in a cream cable-knit sweater and denim shorts, stands behind a crackling campfire holding up a piece of driftwood, flinging her arms wide and leaning forward with her mouth open as she tells a dramatic story. Sparks fly into the dark. Friends listen around the fire: a young woman wrapped in a blanket stares wide-eyed, someone holds a marshmallow on a stick and a scruffy dog barks up at her. A guitar and an enamel mug lie in the sand.

A misty sea cliff covered in pink sea thrift flowers. A young woman with a long black braid, an olive waxed jacket and rubber boots stands on the narrow path holding a wicker basket and reaches up to touch the nose of a huge grey-green dragon. The dragon's horned, scaly head leans out of a cave in the cliff face, lowers and rubs gently against her cheek while she laughs with her eyes closed. A wooden walking stick lies on the path, and rocky islands sit in the grey sea below.

In an empty old factory hall with tall arched windows, warm sunbeams shine through the dusty air. A young woman with long dark hair, a denim shirt, cream trousers and white trainers smiles with her eyes closed and her arms spread out, then turns slowly in a full circle on the dusty floor and faces the front again, still smiling. A young man in a jacket leans in the doorway and watches her. Rubble, wooden pallets and a rusty wheelbarrow lie around the hall.

A wet riverside path on a cloudy spring day with blossom trees and an old lamp post. A young woman in a blue tweed jacket, white skirt and white trainers stands stuck in the middle, holding her head with both hands. On her left a brick tunnel under the path is flooded with brown water that covers the way. On her right a large grey goose spreads its wings and hisses at her, blocking the path ahead. At the end she throws her arms out wide in despair. A railway bridge crosses in the background.

A sunny old-town street. On a yellow plastered wall a door and a garden view are painted so realistically that they look like a real open archway. A young woman in a denim jacket, lilac top and white pleated skirt presses her hand flat against the painted door and stares at it with her mouth wide open, surprised that it is only a flat wall. Friends at a small cafe table laugh at her, one covering her mouth, and a waiter stands behind. A pink blossom tree, green shutters, red flowers and petals on the cobbles fill the scene.

A retro living room with orange patterned wallpaper, a brown corduroy sofa and a fluffy rug. A young man in an open light blue shirt and cream trousers stands smiling happily with a long orange and red snake around his neck and resting on his hand. Right beside him a young woman in a lilac hoodie screams in horror, jumps up onto the arm of the sofa with her knees raised and finally covers her eyes. A cushion and a spilled bowl of popcorn lie on the rug.

A calm, old-fashioned consulting room. A young man in a rust T-shirt and beige trousers lies on a green velvet sofa, talking and gesturing with his hands, and at the end rests his hands on his chest. Behind him a young woman in a green jumper sits on a wooden chair with a notebook, listening closely with a slight smile. The room has a tall floor lamp, a deep red curtain, a green tiled stove, a glass of water on a side table, a patterned rug and a herringbone wooden floor.

A café terrace on a cobbled square on a sunny day. A young woman in a yellow cardigan and black skirt sits at a table with a long white tablecloth, holding up a round white lid in one hand and looking down with narrowed eyes towards the ground. The young man opposite her in a white polo shirt sips from a coffee cup with wide, nervous eyes. Under the table a puddle of water spreads on the cobbles, right beside a white French bulldog sitting on the ground. A waiter walks past behind them.
